items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Terminology 52:1
items.html: (To the question) What is the coupling of voice and speech? The coupling of the KHB of ZON, called the coupling of kisses, namely the coupling of the inner Partzuf of ZA, called voice, with the inner Partzuf of the Nukva, called speech, is called by the name the coupling of voice and speech. (Item 182).
